result.strongest_objection: The mandated inline code '!hasHead && errors.As(rerr, &RegistryHeadAbsentError)' is syntactically invalid Go. The doc explicitly proposes 'RegistryHeadAbsentError' as a new custom error type ('The proposed type is unallocated in this package'). In Go, you cannot take the address of a type name. This violates Bounded Verification (Axiom 5) because the exact mandated logic cannot compile.
result.catch: Invalid Go syntax in the required typed-absence shared-helper repair snippet.
result.proposed_fix: Revise the mandated snippet to instantiate the target type before passing its pointer: `var target RegistryHeadAbsentError; !hasHead && errors.As(rerr, &target)`. Alternatively, if a sentinel variable is intended instead of a custom type, define `var ErrRegistryHeadAbsent = errors.New(...)` and mandate `errors.Is(rerr, ErrRegistryHeadAbsent)`.
